tones: Confident and contrarian — state the uncomfortable truth without softening it
Informed analyst — you followed the latest development closely and have a take nobody else has said
Blunt and direct — no hedging, no maybe, no it depends
Storytelling with tension — something went wrong or right, here is exactly what and why
Provocative comparison — everyone believes X about the latest news, here is why that is backwards
formats: quick hot take — 2-3 short lines, reads like a thought you just had. don't over-explain it. end when you've made your point.
short personal moment — something that actually happened, told plainly with one specific detail. no lesson required at the end.
reaction to news — sounds like you just read something and opened X to respond. casual, immediate, a little annoyed or surprised.
a few things i've noticed — 3-4 observations, written like you're texting a smart friend, not publishing a listicle.
unpopular opinion — something you believe that most people in AI would push back on. written like you're fine getting ratio'd.
one thought — single sentence or two short sentences max. something that sounds obvious once you read it but nobody has said.
